indexes_at_measurement.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_reviews_pk ON olist.order_reviews USING btree (review_id, order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON olist.orders USING btree (order_id)

verification.method: Independent Python latest-review selection and delay classification

benchmark.method: perf_counter: SQLAlchemy execute and full result fetch on one connection
benchmark.cache: warm; no cache flush; no concurrency load

question: Q3 latest review satisfaction versus calendar-day delivery delay

semantics.scope: delivered orders with eligible flag, known dates and delivery at/after purchase
semantics.delay_days: actual delivery DATE minus estimated DATE; same date is zero
semantics.review_selection: latest answer timestamp, then creation timestamp, then review_id DESC
semantics.weight: one selected review per order; all other review rows retained in source
semantics.missing_review: order retained in coverage, score statistics exclude NULL
semantics.review_timing: pre-delivery responses retained and counted separately
semantics.interpretation: descriptive association; no causal or significance claim
semantics.absent_buckets: no invented zero rows; all-unreviewed buckets have NULL score statistics

scope: Q3 initial measurement only; no new indexes, views or other questions
